bundledApp.coverage: Root and nested Layer controls use the same Parameter IDs as the Inspector, with two-way value synchronization, keyboard access, Undo/Redo, and one history entry for a held vertical drag. The accessible Blend Mode selector has no visible label. Both controls remain hittable in a 286.8 CSS px dock, and the Opacity rail stays pinned during horizontal scrolling. Same-ID reload and offscreen Inspector edits pass on the 1000×1000 sparse Matrix with five Opacity sliders mounted at the observed position.
